name: Usotsuki Akuma to Watashi
original_name: うそつきあくまとわたし
source:
Mizuki is a normal high school student. One morning, she wakes up in the middle of a forest she's never been in before. While wandering around, she meets a guy who introduces himself as Ririto and decides to keep her company.

[Translated from [url=http://thunders.silk.to/game/usoakuma/]official website[/url]]
translation:
瑞树是一名普通的高中生。某天早晨，她在一片从未去过的森林中醒来。徘徊期间，她遇见了一名自称利利多的男子，对方决定陪着她。

[译自[url=http://thunders.silk.to/game/usoakuma/]官方网站[/url]]
